case_coverage.note: A repeated random seed on one nominal state is a distinct seeded case, not a new initial-state ID or nominal vector.
case_coverage.case_bank_role: Candidate seeds; unused entries are not missing required collection
case_coverage.receipt_scope: Case counts cover committed episode receipts; interrupted/uncommitted attempts remain separately charged and are not padded into learning histories

feature_contract.pooling: separate NumPy float32 mask-weighted means after native hidden materialization
feature_contract.normalization: raw frozen hidden values; student fits normalization on training tasks only
feature_contract.execution: standalone native prefix hidden materialized on host before pooling; native prefix recomputed for motor; both costs recorded
feature_contract.hidden_materialization: standalone module_jit output transferred to host before reduction

noise_contract: 32D tied across native H10; warmup unbounded N(0,I), then SAC clipped[-1,1]; no rescaling
deployment_shots: one support plus query is a separate evaluation protocol
